hypotheses.H1: Propagated primary-input activity can deviate materially from delay-aware internal ECC activity on the same netlist.
hypotheses.H2: Mapping, capacitance, logic sharing, registers and delay-induced activity can jointly affect ECC energy.
hypotheses.H3: Data activity, operation class, utilization and injected error conditions can change the architecture preference.
hypotheses.H4: Manufacturing burden can change the ranking implied by operational energy.
hypotheses.H5: Manufacturing boundary, deployment grid, workload and lifetime can change the conditional carbon decision.
hypotheses.H6: Lifecycle selection can improve on area or energy selection over a declared deployment set.

admission.physical: Use a new configuration identity and require route, setup and hold separately, with source, tool, Liberty, parasitic and constraint hashes.
admission.delay_power: Require a matched physical run, relevant delay and check qualification, a passing scoreboard, verified internal activity import and measured coverage. Any restricted production protocol requires explicit approval.
admission.carbon: Compare matched service and implementation cohorts. Historical and hypothetical operands remain labeled. Leave missing required inputs unavailable.
admission.optimization: Require materiality and feasible held-out evidence before changing RTL or claiming an improved implementation.
